Subject: PO requirements and invoice cadence — net terms & discount flow

Hi Vanessa,

Quick note from Crescent Procurement — we want to confirm a few mandatory fields and cadence expectations before legal signs the SOW:

- All invoices must reference a PO number on the invoice header and on each line item. We generally issue a blanket PO and then reference it per invoice.
- Our standard net terms are Net30. We do offer early-pay discounts but only when they are applied to the invoice itself (not as post-invoice credits).
- Invoice cadence: we prefer monthly consolidated invoices rather than weekly micro-invoices; monthly is easier for our AP reconciliation.
- For discounts: our finance team requires the discount to be visible as a line-item reduction and tied to the PO if it is to be honored by AP. We cannot accept a separate credit memo as a guaranteed discount.

Attached is our PO template for field mapping (Crescent_PO_Template.xlsx). Can Redwood confirm you can include PO header and PO number per line, and whether your billing system can surface an "early-pay" deduction directly on the invoice? Also please confirm whether you can map our GL/BU fields (we'll include a sample mapping).

If we can get those items confirmed this week, legal will be able to proceed to signature.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Senior Procurement Manager
Crescent Data Systems
procurement@crescentdatasys.com

Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence — net terms & discount flow

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list. Confirming Redwood can meet the majority of these constraints; below is a proposed approach and a few notes:

- PO on header and per line: yes — we can include the PO number at the invoice header and replicate it in the line-item metadata.
- Net terms: we are fine with Net30 as the standard.
- Invoice cadence: monthly consolidated invoices work for us; we will bundle usage/overages for the month and send one invoice per blanket PO.
- Early-pay discount: we can present an early-pay line-item (e.g., "2% Net14 early pay discount") that reduces invoice total, but our finance team needs to confirm whether the discount is an automatic deduction or handled via credit memo.

Proposal to bridge: Redwood will provide a monthly consolidated invoice with the blanket PO reflected. For commercial flexibility we can offer a one-time onboarding discount of 5% on the first month if Crescent signs a 12-month commitment. Separately, we can expose a 3% early-pay discount if invoices are paid within 14 days; that discount will be rendered as a line-item deduction on the invoice when enabled.

I've attached the latest SOW and an invoice sample (Redwood_Master_SOW_v3.pdf, invoice_sample.csv) so you can confirm fields and format.

Next steps / asks:
- Maya: please confirm if Crescent can accept a 5% one-time onboarding discount + 3% early-pay (Net14) via invoice deduction, or if legal requires a different structure.
- Tim: if you need the discount reflected differently (e.g., as rebate schedules), flag that so we can route to sales ops.
- Ben/Priya: can you confirm on the accounting side whether the early-pay can be applied as an invoice deduction (rather than post-invoice credit)?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

Ben / Vanessa,

Finance confirms: we can accept Net30 as the contractual term. For the 3% early-pay Net14 discount, two options exist:

1) Billing shows the early-pay line-item automatically: this requires that AP include a payment-code or remittance field at payment time that we can detect. Technically possible but requires mapping the PO and remittance token.
2) If AP does not send a payment indicator, Finance will accept a manual credit applied the month after payment; legal may not like that, so preferable to do option #1.

Required invoice fields for automatic processing:
- PO Number (header + line)
- Invoice ID
- Invoice Date
- Due Date and Payment Terms field (Net30 / Net14)
- Line-item SKU/Description, Qty, Unit Price, Extended Amount
- Discount line (type + percent) if applied
- GL/BU code mapping field (Crescent field id)
- Remittance token (to reconcile early-pay)

I attached our PO template with the field mapping we need (PO_template.xlsx). If Crescent can populate the remittance token and include PO 2026-9001 on each invoice, we can have billing emit a 3% early-pay deduction automatically. Otherwise we'll handle via a manual credit.

Priya Natarajan
Director, Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
